title: Compare bounded counting with a stack trace
description: You inspect the supplied recognizers and their printed results without changing either machine.

steps.description: You read a counting simulation capped by MAX_STATES=3. It scans the initial a segment and then the following b segment before checking its counts.
You read a second recognizer that pushes markers and removes them as symbols arrive. Its branches can return early with a rejection reason.

steps.question: Does show=False prevent the stack snapshots from being stored in trace?
steps.answer: The append runs for every processed symbol regardless of show. show controls only the later printing of the collected snapshots.

steps.description: You see the capped simulation reject aaaabbbb while the stack recognizer accepts it in the supplied run. The printed trace grows to aaaa and then shrinks to empty.
